notes.title: Update v1.6
notes.content:
This update includes the following:

- Inventory improvements
- inventory open/close improved (mouse wheel added)
- inventory bag updated
- Reminder to use right click added
- Notes improved
- Bush hidden spot disabled after use
- Toolbox comment improved
- Menu scene lightning animation improved
- Sparks animation for house antenna added
- Inventory items comments improved
- Tree index interfere with character walking fixed
- Hint-system bug fixed
- Climbing up the tree-house improved
- Tape combined with block fixed
- Objects combined with chest updated
- Water bottle combined with faucet bug fixed
- Kitchen faucet animation glitch fixed
- Table drawer animation updated
- Tree-house squirrel run on beam animation added
- S10 portal comments improved
- System "pause" deactivated
- Radio button more prominent - spider and poster added
- Menu button in the inventory fixed
- Hot-spots for bushes fixed
- Hot-spot for the bridge fixed
- Hot-spots for the intro scene fixed
- Removing the battery from the flashlight fixed

- Several other bug fixes, improvements and animation updates.

I'm doing all these updates and fixes on my own and help with testing and polishing is greatly appreciated. If you encounter new bugs or something weird, please let me know and I will try to patch them ASAP.
For some changes to have effect it is recommended not to use old save-games.

Thank you for playing my game!

Until next time,
Kapa
